snippet.title: Metal Surge // SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
SAGE Booth ► https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/metal-surge.2616/

Metal Surge is my entry for this year SAGE, a 2d platformer shooter with multi-phase boss fights and multiple upgrades that change how you play and are required for beating it's challenges, have fun.

Developed by 
sirlees
